results.name: FM-15 selection model = spec-literal reference over 3 000 random click / Ctrl / Shift / Ctrl+Shift / keyboard sequences
SH-09 back / forward history = browser model (entries + index) over 3 000 random sequences, incl. the 50-entry cap
FM-03 / FM-13 conflict-free names: never in use, the smallest free candidate, copies of copies do not grow, dirs and dotfiles keep their name
FM-06 context-menu model: concise ⊂ full, type-to-search matches every word (label + keywords, case- and accent-folded), order kept
FM-01 sort: folders first in both directions, numeric-aware names, size / date keys, vs a reference comparator
FM-01 paths: join / parent / base / breadcrumbs round-trip over random paths; root never doubles or vanishes

WM-08 remembered geometry: close records the normal rect per module|host (restore rect when maximized), the next open reuses it, an explicit rect wins, no exact stacking, fits a smaller viewport, bounded, closeAll records all
